content.text: {"id": "mm7303a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "In this survey of nearly 4 million U.S. adults, prevalence of diagnosed cardiometabolic diseases varied up to twofold"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Prevalence was 11.5% for the aggregated Asian category; among disaggregated Asian subgroups, prevalence ranged from 6.3% for Vietnamese adults to 15.2% for Filipino adults."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Prevalence of each cardiometabolic disease was estimated from multivariable logistic models adjusted for age, sex, and survey year."}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The overall prevalence of diabetes was 10.9%"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "among disaggregated Asian subgroups, prevalence ranged from 6.3% for Vietnamese adults to 15.2% for Filipino adults"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "adjusting for age, sex, and survey year"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "In this survey of nearly 4 million U.S. adults"}]}, {"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "BRFSS is an annual random-digit–dialed landline and cellular telephone-based survey representative of noninstitutionalized adults"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Prevalence of each cardiometabolic disease was estimated from multivariable logistic models adjusted for age, sex, and survey year."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Sample weights and design variables were used to account for the complex survey design."}, {"loc": "table 2", "q": "Prevalence is adjusted for age, sex, and survey year."}, {"loc": "table 2", "q": "Estimate has a relative SE ≥0.30 and is therefore considered statistically unreliable."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
